name: Domariaganj

queries.query: Domariaganj Uttar Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records Bhulekh BhuNaksha

Official UP Bhulekh portal states that the Board of Revenue provides land records and links parcel-related services including BhuNaksha.
Siddharthnagar district government revenue page identifies the Board of Revenue, Government of Uttar Pradesh.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: UP BhuNaksha is a state viewer with district, tehsil, and village selection; the official Bhulekh portal describes UP land-record coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Administrative selection for Siddharthnagar / Domariaganj / डुमरियागंज was verified, but no nonempty parcel polygon response was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The selected village is reported by the viewer as hasData=false and its map extent is all zero; this is a map availability result for that selection, not evidence that Domariaganj citywide has no parcels.
The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted. No exact-point hit or miss was asserted.

The viewer JavaScript references wkbGeometry, id, and kide in parcel-detail paths, but no parcel response was obtained, so native identity, CRS, geometry type, and safe polygon schema remain unverified.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect alternative official UP revenue/map routes or a different valid village selection, without treating this map-unavailable result as citywide absence.
